**S07 (17.7 s)**
Scores: emotion/story 2 · sound off 2 · pacing 2 · composition 2

- **8.87 s:** The frame is completely empty except the title and footer, right when "It exists because the thirty-year…" is spoken, so the stack world just disappears. Fix: don't cut away. Move the camera off the gold stack onto the two rate lines so the stack visibly turns into, or sits beside, the gap.
- **12.41 s:** The lines are drawing without labels, squeezed into the top-left third, with the bottom two-thirds empty. Fix: start the draw at about 9.0 s ("thirty-year"), scale the chart to fill the frame, and have the right-edge endpoints arrive on "higher rate" (10.4 s).
- **15.96 s:** The gap is the subject, but its bracket is tiny (about 45 px) and the stack never appears again, so nothing ties the 0.67 back to the stack. Fix: zoom in on the endpoint gap and drop a sliver of the gold stack into the bracket, so the gap is filled by the price.
- **1.77 s:** Two unexplained white pillars on the right are cut off by the ILLUSTRATIVE badge and pull the eye away from the stack. The Tessa label also covers her body. Fix: take the pillars out of this beat (or set them back in depth) and move Tessa's label below her feet.

**S08 (17.1 s)**
Scores: emotion/story 3 · sound off 4 · pacing 3 · composition 3

- **1.71 s:** The 30-year stack is the same height the 15-year stack ends up, so for a moment it reads as the small one. Fix: hold it at zero until "charge" (3.0 s), then grow it fast so it peaks on "thousand" (5.2 s).
- **5.12–8.53 s:** Nothing moves for about 3.4 s. Fix: keep the tall stack growing slowly through "dollars in interest," or pull the camera back so it seems to tower over the frame.
- **11.95 s:** The short stack is already there but has no label until about 15 s, even though "fifteen years" was said at 10.3 s. Fix: start the short stack's rise on "fifteen" and land its label on "two hundred ten thousand" (12.9 s).
- **15.36 s:** Everything sits in the left 60% of the frame, the cut-off white pillars are still on the left edge, and the $267k difference isn't shown. Fix: remove the pillars, center the two stacks, and shade the empty space above the short stack up to the tall stack's top so the saving is visible.
